title: VeriChip implant, Raytheon lineage, and retaliation suggestion

tellings.quote: The chip was introduced to the market in 2002, just a few years before Gary's experience in 2005.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the VeriChip, a small chip implanted in the body, sold by a company called Applied Digital Solutions, which he connects to the defence company Raytheon. According to Michels, the chip came on the market in 2002, a few years before what happened to Gary McKinnon, a hacker who says he broke into NASA computers, in 2005. Michels suggests the timing may point to a kind of retaliation, which, if true, would tie the chip to how McKinnon was treated.
